summative_rubric.title: Real-Life Modelling — Summative Rubric

rows.expectation_text: apply the process of mathematical modelling to represent, analyse, make predictions, and provide insight into real-life situations

levels.descriptor: Cannot identify a real-life situation or ask a math question.
With prompts, walks through 2-3 of the 5 modelling steps.
Independently walks through all 5 modelling steps with a coherent topic.
Walks through all 5 steps with a coherent topic and includes a refinement based on the data.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Apply this rubric to the Lesson 5 capstone evidence.
summative_rubric.layout_description: One letter page, landscape. 5-column grid with 1 row.

image_placeholders.description: A printable summative rubric grid in B&W on a landscape letter page. 5-column grid with 1 row (C4).
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image AS_RUBRIC: keywords (rubric, levels) name what the rubric grid captures.

summative_task_script.title: Lesson 5 Summative Task — My Real-Life Model
summative_task_script.purpose: End-of-unit summative integrating all 5 modelling steps for C4.
administration_steps: Walk through the Capstone Modelling Template.
Circulate and prompt freezing children with situation cards.
Score: 4 of 5 steps complete = L3; 5 of 5 with refinement = L4.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Coherent topic (out of 2) + 5 steps complete (out of 5) + refinement quality (out of 3) = 10.

evidence_per_expectation.C4: Capstone template shows situation, question, data, prediction, and reflection. L4 includes a refinement.
